summary: Frontend-only retest of SKITRACK preview (vite preview /preview.html, HashRouter) focused on the fixes of iteration_2. Verified: routing stability (nav-compare, home-shortcut, home-all-stations, nav-home, mobile tabbar-compare — URL stays on #/comparer for 5 s, compare-screen stays mounted, history +1 only), deep link #/comparer with a pre-existing persisted tab, full station sheet #/stations/:id (hero, name, facts, sticky, see-lodgings, compare, save + real Open-Meteo weather differing per station), station -> lodgings -> reservation flow, new Logements UI (ribbon + photo + ribbon-sheet link, badges 'Le moins cher / pers.' and 'Le plus près des pistes', 'Photo non fournie par {source}' on blurred backdrop, StayBar with lodging/total/go), filters regression (chip-budget-1000 3->1, lodgings-reset 3, sort total_asc reorders, correct singular/plural '1 logement' / '3 logements'), forfaits x travelers fix (travelers=4 -> Forfaits · 4 pers. 1 436 € = 4 x 359, stay-bar-total 2 726 € identical to checkout-total), 3D home scene (WebGL canvas, mountain relief, chairlift with pylons + red cabins, chalet village, firs, snowfall; NO computeBoundingSphere/NaN error, zero JS/console errors besides expected ERR_UNSAFE_PORT), the 6 popular photos are all plausible winter/ski images (bird + green summer frames are gone), mobile 390x844 (stay-bar-summary pill 'Modifier' -> search-stay-bar-compact, stay-bar above tabbar, zero horizontal overflow: scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390), dark theme via nav-more > theme-toggle (.rc-h1 = rgb(242,247,251), .rc-muted = rgb(188,202,216)), and regression routes #/favoris, #/suivi, #/reglages + their 'Ajouter/Chercher un domaine' buttons navigating to #/comparer with no loop, unknown route #/nawak -> #/. All four iteration_2 blockers are fixed. Only medium/low residual issues remain.

ui_bugs.component: StationCard snow badge / StationRibbon / StationScreen 'Neige au sol'
ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM (carried over from iteration_2, still open): mixed '0 cm' vs '—' for snow depth. Home/compare card of Tignes shows '0 / 13 cm' (base = 0 while no depth is actually measured), lodgings-ribbon-snow shows '0 cm / 0 cm' on one load and '— / —' on another for the same station (Val Thorens), and the station sheet shows 'Neige au sol 0 cm / 0 cm' while station-hero-weather correctly prints '— neige 24 h'. Same data, three renderings — pick one rule (— when not measured) so the 'aucune donnée inventée' promise holds.

LOW: the 'Ajouter un domaine' (SelectionPage.tsx:266) and 'Chercher un domaine' (TrackingPage.tsx:112) buttons have no data-testid (had to be reached by accessible name). Add data-testid="sel-go-search" / "track-go-search" for the testids promised in the brief.
ui_bugs.selector: text=Ajouter un domaine, text=Chercher un domaine

ui_bugs.issue: LOW / to eyeball: the CSS override works (computed color AND -webkit-text-fill-color = rgb(242,247,251), element-level screenshot of the H1 shows pixels 242/247/251, no ancestor opacity/filter/blend), but in full-viewport captures 'Logements à Val Thorens' / 'Demande de réservation' still read visibly dimmer than the card titles next to them. Worth a human look; no longer a blocker.

integration_issues.issue: NOT A BUG, but a testing trap: the preview shim only injects the 3 fake listings when the page is LOADED on #/logements or #/reservation (shim.ts parses location.hash at boot). Navigating in-app from a station sheet therefore shows 'Aucune annonce relevée / Indisponible en prévisualisation' and lodgings-count '0 logements', with no lodge-card/stay-bar. All lodgings assertions must be run after page.goto('#/logements') + reload.

integration_issues.flow: Open-Meteo batch for the visible list
integration_issues.issue: LOW: the list request bundles 40 domains x 2 elevations into a single very long querystring (~4 kB) and gets net::ERR_ABORTED whenever the user navigates/reloads during the flight, leaving lodgings-ribbon-snow at '— / —' until a later round. Consider chunking the batch (e.g. 10 domains per call) so a cancelled navigation does not lose the whole relevé.

issues: Only the 'Choisissez d'abord une station.' panel is rendered at the top; ~700 px of empty white below it and no footer — the page looks broken/unfinished on desktop 1920x1080

La Daille, Le Fornet and Tignes still expose strictly identical figures (341,5 km, 84 remontées, 1 559–3 456 m, 335 €) because the linked-pass aggregates are reused for every village of Espace Killy — the comparison between two villages of the same pass carries no information (carried over from iteration_2)
The fixed StayBar overlays the last card / ribbon content while scrolling (no extra bottom padding on the scroll container); nothing is unreachable but content passes under the bar

action_items: Unify snow rendering: show '—' (never '0 cm') when Open-Meteo returns no measured depth — station-card-snow-*, lodgings-ribbon-snow and the station sheet 'Neige au sol' currently disagree with each other.
Add data-testid to the SelectionPage 'Ajouter un domaine' and TrackingPage 'Chercher un domaine' buttons.
Fill or shorten the #/logements guard page (empty 700 px + missing footer).
Optional: chunk the Open-Meteo list batch so an aborted request does not blank the ribbon snow; add bottom padding on mobile so the fixed StayBar does not overlap content.
critical_code_review_comments: router.tsx RouteStoreSync is now strictly one-way (URL -> state.tab) and tabOfPath maps '/stations' and '/reservation' — this is what removed the oscillation and unblocked /stations/:id. Keep it one-way; any future screen->navigate effect will reintroduce the loop.
state/appState.tsx is 1166 lines and state/selectors.tsx 641 lines — both exceed the 700-line guideline; split appState into store + persistence + referential slices.

weather.tsx builds one Open-Meteo URL for up to 40 domains x 2 elevations; the querystring is ~4 kB and the whole batch is lost on abort. Chunking would also protect against provider URL-length limits.
MountainScene.tsx is 499 lines of inline R3F geometry; the NaN geometry bug is gone but the file would benefit from being split per prop (relief, lift, village, snowfall).
seed_data_creation: None. Used the preview shim's 3 fake listings (ids 9001-9003, forced lodgingDomainId=1 -> Val Thorens) and the embedded referential (283 domaines). localStorage cleared before routing tests.
test_credentials: None required; /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not exist (no auth in this app)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test only via https://ski-stay-selector.preview.emergentagent.com/preview.html#/<route>, always page.reload() after changing the hash. IMPORTANT: the fake listings exist only if the page is loaded directly on #/logements or #/reservation (shim.ts reads location.hash at boot) — in-app navigation to Logements legitimately shows the empty state. Hashes like '#/logements/dark' do NOT work as a route (unknown route -> #/), use nav-more then data-testid="theme-toggle" for dark mode. Expected noise: net::ERR_UNSAFE_PORT on http://127.0.0.1:0/api/... and an empty MapLibre canvas. Verified fixed in this iteration: navigation oscillation, /stations/:id reachability, deep-link override, forfaits x travelers (costPeople), MountainScene NaN, popular-station photos, FR plurals, dark .rc-h1 CSS. Still open: '0 cm' vs '—' snow inconsistency, missing testids on favoris/suivi CTAs, empty lodgings-guard page, identical Espace Killy village figures.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_2's oscillation came from two bidirectional effects in RouteStoreSync; it is resolved because the store->navigate effect was removed (URL is the single source of truth) and tabOfPath now maps '/stations' and '/reservation'. The pricing bug is resolved by costPeople using state.travelers instead of adultsCount(state.people). The residual snow inconsistency is a formatting decision (0 from Open-Meteo current.snow_depth is rendered as a measured 0 in some components and as '—' in others), not a data-fetch failure.
